query:
UPDATE channel_members cm
                SET section_id = $3
               FROM channels c
              WHERE cm.channel_id = $1
                AND cm.user_id = $2
                AND c.id = cm.channel_id
                AND (
                    $3::uuid IS NULL
                    OR EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM sidebar_sections s
                         WHERE s.id = $3 AND s.user_id = $2 AND s.workspace_id = c.workspace_id
                    )
                )
